quote.text: To create the Bayesian tree, our final alignment (341 sequences, 582 bp) was exported from MEGA in nexus format, priors were chosen in BEAUTi v2.4.7 (100 million MCMC chain length, strict clock, yule model, GTR+G+I), the analysis was run in BEAST v2.4.7 and the resulting “.trees” file and posterior distribution were summarized in TreeAnnotator v2.4.7 (10% burn‐in), after checking the log file in Tracer v2.4.7 for effective sample size (posterior ESS of 4,396, likelihood ESS of 2,420) (Bouckaert et al., 2014).
